text_block_list.text:
It's the opening day of the Mainichi
Okan, an
important step toward the
Japan Cup.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After I give her a bit of encouragement,
El
Condor Pasa declares she'll make a
sweeping
victory.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, her classmate Грасс Вандер
will also
be running in the race, along
with the peerless
Сайленс Судзука.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Matched against incredibly talented

Umamusume, she heads to the race to
prove
herself worthy of the Japan Cup.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
